svg.text: The protein appears first. The enzyme starts working six hours later.
Same reactor run, same shell permeate — our ELISA against our DNPH assay
We think the enzyme matures after it is secreted — it only works as a multimer and needs a PLP cofactor.
Single well per time point, so this is a shape and not a kinetic profile. A second trial of the same experiment peaked at 24 h instead.
The maturation account is our hypothesis, not a result. Say “we think”.
